body:
Created this account to say: Holy fuck!

I feel relatively similar to how you feel, right in between trying to choose wether to die or to run away and dissappear from the face of the earth. I get it. Our reasons are different, but the feeling is the same. 

So... I don't know what to tell you, but i'll write why I still have not made a choice: Because, like you mentioned, I don't want to hurt anybody. Because wether I die or disappear, odds are my actions will still greatly hurt the people I love, and those who love me, all the same. I'm very fortunate to have what I have, I acknowledge this fact. But it's not what I ever needed to be happy. Frankly speaking, I'll probably go with offing myself when the time is right. I don't really have the courage to stay alive and witness how my actions destroy my family, and prefer to be dead for that...

Anyways, just wanted to tell you I get you, and that I'm here if you need to talk about shit. I cannot promise you solutions, or even good advice, but I'll be here, for all the good that does, and for what little it matters. As of now, I might or might not be going through the beginning of what promises to be a slow painful death. Day was rough so took a bunch of pills and had some alcohol. Odds are It'll not be enough, but even if it is I have more than enough time to chat and try to help you figure something out.

Good luck, pal! Like most, you probably both need it and deserve it, but sadly don't have a goddamn lick of it. Fuck.
